notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Supa Fly has a new update with a few changes and improvements.


*  Changed the Wobbler track to a different configuration as the old layout was too difficult for starting players.

*  The UI has had colour changes and positioning improvements along with added information in the instructions screen.

*  Racetrack model position has been adjusted when selecting tracks.

*  A difficulty mode has been implemented when starting a new game.  There are now Easy and Normal modes to select from.  Easy mode nerfs the AI corner speed.
